The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Milagro''' lay at the confluence of two important [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperroutes]], the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]].

==Description==
Milagro was located in the [[Chaykin sector/Legends|Chaykin sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="EAOC" /> at the intersection of [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet had a thin [[atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="DF:JK" /> and was a prosperous trade and manufacturing world. Milagro was ruled by its own noble houses, descendants of the first settlers of the planet.<ref name="FaDCR" /> 

==History==
Milagro was discovered during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]], that lasted from [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] to [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was settled by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] colonists.<ref name="FaDCR" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3 astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] known as [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]] was stolen from the Republic by agents of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and was reprogrammed at a Republic base on Milagro to spy for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]].

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a large Clone Wars-era military base on the planet.<ref name="FaDCR" />

By the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the planet had at least one metropolis of domes, towers such as minarets, and aerial archways. Much of the building material was [[glass/Legends|glass]], creating translucent and iridescent effects. At its thinner-populated suburbs there was a military base. Smaller groups of dwellings were arranged in a [[Silicon/Legends|silicone]] plain. On a nearby hill there was an emerald-colored temple with a statue.<ref name="DF:JK" />

The Republic set up a temporary base consisting of sixty-three sprawling prefab buildings with airlocks and inflatable walls, an airstrip, a repair facility and the [[Military Correction Facility 63]]. It was defended by [[Surface-to-air missile|surface-to-air]] [[Missile Battery|missile batteries]].<ref name="DF:JK" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the surface of Milagro was bombarded to slag by the Empire, opting for a [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] operation rather than allowing the resources of the planet to [[Milagro campaign|fall into]] the hands of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TNEC" /> The bombardment destroyed the metropolis, reduced to a shimmering sea of molten glass. After the city was destroyed, the Republic intended to build a communications mast; its six anchors were to be fused under the molten glass surface that used to belong to the city buildings.<ref name="DF:JK" />

[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] later briefly set up headquarters in the ''[[New Hope]]'' in orbit of the planet. Three [[standard month/Legends|months]] after a temporary New Republic base was established, the ''New Hope'' was attacked by the Empire and wounded from the ''[[Mercy (hospital ship)|Mercy]]'' manned available [[starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the base to defend the [[flagship/Legends|flagship]].<ref name="DF:JK" /> For his heroism in the [[Battle in the Milagro system|ensuing battle]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was promoted to [[General/Legends|General]].<ref name="TNEC" /> After the battle, the dead were buried and the starships were repaired at the military base.<ref name="DF:JK" />

The Milagro system was [[Battle of the Milagro system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', the ''New Hope'' is seen orbiting an unnamed planet recently devastated by the Empire, also described as having seas of molten glass, remnant of its former glass cities. Although it could be an appearance of Milagro, context of the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio adaptation]] suggests that it was [[Shackel|another planet]].
